name: Johor Bahru
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid. The city cadastral layer is positively identified and the query was centered on the exact point, but public feature geometry is token-gated; exact parcel coverage was not verified. GeoJohor public viewer TLS validation failed in the inspected client and was not bypassed. No parcel geometry or owner/address data retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The City Council of Johor Bahru GeoJB public ArcGIS portal exposes a public item titled LOT KADASTER. Its app configuration names a Lot JUPEM FeatureServer layer and describes the data as the National Digital Cadastral Database provided by JUPEM. A bounded anonymous query at the ranked point returned ArcGIS HTTP 499 Token Required; no token or login was attempted.
